manifest.source: Upstream-generated OpenRPC gateway contract and VALID_HOOKS of the exact v2026.9.24 source revision, joined to isolated-home type-preserving stdio tui_gateway runtime evidence.

terminal.notes: Native Node Ink TUI. Semantics are never derived from terminal text.

tui-gateway.notes: Peer-to-peer JSON-RPC over stdio to tui_gateway.entry, or the same dispatcher over WebSocket handle_ws: client methods, server→client requests (srq- ids), and event notifications. Resuming a live session attaches the caller beside its existing clients.

plugin-hook.notes: In-process plugin hooks. Default tui_gateway.entry does not load user plugins until discover_plugins runs.

shell-hook.notes: Configured shell scripts receive a serialized projection of plugin-hook kwargs and may return JSON.

outbound-webhook.notes: Notify-only hooks.outbound POSTs. Default tui_gateway.entry does not register them.

state-db.notes: HERMES_HOME/state.db is resume/replay only. Not a live event stream.

acp.notes: Separate hermes acp / hermes-acp host behind the optional acp extra. Forbidden beside a native-TUI session.

artifacts.notes: Integrity is pyproject.toml of the tagged checkout, not a source-archive or installed-console digest; the census ran in an unattested survey environment.
Original acquired build retained byte-for-byte in the build-history record; superseded by the reviewed rust-cyclonedx-v1 recipe. This identity is not the new recipe identity.

claims.harness: isolated HERMES_HOME, loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, stdio tui_gateway census sidecar answering server→client requests, plugin-hook dump and outbound webhook collector
source pin, --version, --help, rejected option, hermes acp --version/--check

claims.notes: Names equal the contract registry and registered handler table of the same checkout. The contract establishes declared shape, not runtime reachability.
Digest-pinned VALID_HOOKS, hook envelopes, hook result handling, and the inline-diff preview projection.

The two-build diagnostic proves a reproducible recipe on its runner. It does not attest a production acquisition or transfer runtime claims. The original build is historical; the production recipe needs its own immutable manifest and protected four-platform verification.

limitations: Only linux-x64 executed the source-revision checkout, in an unattested survey environment (Python 3.11.18, not the reviewed recipe's pinned toolchain). Other platforms are declared execution environments.

Plugin hooks and outbound webhooks required the census sidecar. Default tui_gateway.entry does not register them.
Hook payload schemas are sampled from the census; unencountered hooks have no payload schema.
